messages:
alyssa: Anyone else seeing p99 generation latency spikes on private clusters after last night's firewall rule rollout? customer 'AcmeVault' seeing ~3x p99 on short chat workloads.
jamal: Yep, got alerts. Throughput down ~30% on PVPC-3. Spikes are periodic (~every 30s).
marco: Profiler points at kernel fallback. Heavy time in syscalls/send and scheduler wakeups. KV cache hit rate dropped 92% -> 60%.
sara: Timeline: infra rolled DNAT rules for sidecar telemetry last night. conntrack entries jumped after that. Could be port churn.
infra-bot: deploy: firewall-v2 rolled @2004980000 by infra.team
jamal: quick numbers: conntrack -L | wc -l = 118000. nf_conntrack_max is 200000 but we're seeing fast churn + evictions.
alyssa: tcpdump from a node shows src port reuse on same 5-tuple within seconds -> KV cache misses when we canonicalize keys including client_port.
marco: KV cache key currently (client_ip, client_port, model_id, prefix_hash). Port reuse + short connections = cache thrash.
sara: batching heuristics also suffer: connection churn shrinks observed batch windows so we end up with micro-batches -> higher per-token latency.
jamal: perf top snippet: __x64_sys_sendto 32%, tcp_sendmsg 18%, schedule 12% ... lots of time in send path.
alyssa: short mitigations: increase conntrack timeouts, widen ephemeral SNAT range, and encourage HTTP keepalive to reuse ports.
marco: check firewall for hairpin NAT / asymmetric path. DNAT + SNAT interplay can cause repeated port mapping changes.
sara: I can prepare a conservative rollback of the DNAT rule (rule id 4521) and test.
alyssa: action: jamal to capture tcpdump+conntrack dump and run perf/top on affected node. also paste kernel-selector.log for fallback decisions.
jamal: grabbing captures now, running perf. ETA ~20m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jamal: upload: https://artifacts.redwood/2005009876/conntrack-pcap.gz
marco: can we add temporary KV sampling so we can correlate per-request port -> kv-miss traces?
sara: rollback scheduled: disabling DNAT rule 4521 in 5m.
infra-bot: action scheduled: rollback-firewall-4521 @2005010500 by sara
jamal: post-rollback quick check on test cluster: p99 480ms -> 150ms, KV hit -> 89%.
alyssa: follow-ups: 1) add guardrails to firewall deploys (conntrack delta threshold) 2) make KV keying port-agnostic where safe 3) add batching fallback to time-window when connection churn high
marco: noted. I'll add a small RFC for KV keying change and impact analysis.
alyssa: thanks everyone. keep captures in the artifact for the incident report.
